name: Find Session Record
purpose: Finds the current user's session record: reads the session id held in the session global; with no id it returns an empty found set, otherwise it finds the session record by that id.
open_question: Leaves error capture off at the end (step 24).

name: Clean up Session Records
purpose: Session clean-up at close: when this is the only user it deletes all session records, otherwise it finds the current session record and deletes it; when the file is open locally it also clears startup and current employee globals.
writes:
Globals::SystemStartupCompleteInd#30 (step 32, global)
Globals::User.CurrentEmployeeId#26 (step 33, global)
Globals::User.CurrentEmployeeName#27 (step 34, global)
delete: session (Delete All Records step 21, found set from step 20 Show All Records)
delete: session (Delete All Records step 26, found set from step 24)
open_question: Step 26 deletes whatever found set remains after Find Session Record; with error capture off, if that find fails it is unclear whether the found set stays as all sessions. The deleted rows are found sets, not keyed by id.

name: Ensure There is Session Record
purpose: Makes sure exactly one valid session record exists for the current user: finds it, deletes extra records when more than one is found, creates one when none, and stores its id and the account name in the session globals.
writes:
session::CurrentSessionId#57 (step 24, current record)
session::CurrentAccountName#60 (step 25, current record)
